Preset pieces

Click a preset to add that piece. If a joint is selected, the preset attaches there. If no grid point is selected, the preset is created as a separate module in the empty field.

Import & Export

Save or share your RaceGOW design
Export

Check to lock the main design on import. Only optional floor links and half-grid supports can be added or removed. Unchecked exports are editable. JSON locks are not tamper-proof.

Import

Current track: editable

Clears any loaded track, including locked files, and starts an editable design without reloading the page.

Build sheet

Four views, START-first steps, and parts list.

Grid point controls

Click any grid intersection on the fixed 6×6 field (X/Y coordinates 0–6) to pick a new starting point. Use Move connected piece to reposition an existing module: select a joint on the piece, switch on Move, then click its new floor grid position. Shift the same X/Y amount, preserving the piece shape.

Grid: no point selected

Build from selected joint

Simple build flow: click a yellow joint, then click the direction arrow beside it on the map. Or press an arrow key: its direction follows the rotated grid on screen. Shift + ↑ / ↓ controls vertical height. The key hints on the buttons update when you rotate the grid.

Support finish

Select a floor link or support to remove it. Required floor links remain protected in locked tracks. Support ends are capped.

View & link editing

Click a link on the map to select it.

Select a link to remove it, change a floor link from optional to required, or replace it by choosing a start end and clicking a direction.

Support rule

No more than 3 consecutive elevated horizontal links without a vertical support connected down to the floor. Ground links are exempt. If a fourth is attempted, the designer blocks it. Start-gate horizontal tops count; their vertical legs can act as supports.

RaceGOW kit limits

Switch on to enforce: 20 required links, 4 elbows, 6 Tees, 6 four-way, 2 five-way. 6 three-way fittings in this kit.

Used links

Connector inventory

Available fittings: 90° elbow, T, 3-way (6 available), 4-way, and 5-way. Every link end touching the floor has a connector marker. Available kit fittings are used for floor contacts first; optional floor-support junctions needing extra stock add a Tee to optional extras. A straight-through joint counts as one T. Six-direction intersections are flagged as needing redesign. Free link ends are not connectors.
